explication: systemd is a system and service manager. The principal workflow is an administrator or service client requesting a unit operation through the manager interface; the manager resolves dependencies into transactions and jobs, executes units, and supervises resulting services. Journald records runtime events, while auxiliary daemons provide device management, DNS, time synchronization, home-directory management, storage-provider access, and resource-pressure control. The tree also shows EFI boot management and diagnostic tooling. Several relationships are inferred from explicit module roles and filenames; unsampled implementations are not treated as confirmed call chains.
